A-G1.description: Acres certified to FSA for grain x last year's NASS/FSA grain ratio.

A-G2.description: FSA all-corn planted x last year's NASS grain / FSA planted.

A-G3.description: Like A-G1 with the median NASS/FSA ratio of the last three years. Selected Tier A grain.

A-G4.description: A-G1 corrected by drought and insured losses.

A-G5.description: Ratio against last year's FSA file from the same point in the season.

A-G9.description: Headline grain. A-G3's state split, scaled to one national FSA x NASS/FSA ratio total. Passes the 2 SE rule vs A-G3 (not 3 SE). Ties NASS's November forecast (1.69% vs 1.66% state, 2017-24).

A-S1.description: Last year's acres pulled toward the 3-year average.

A-S2.description: FSA's silage change where FSA captures >= 75% of silage; A-S1 elsewhere.

A-S3.description: (FSA planted - our grain) x last year's silage share of non-grain, blended with A-S1. Selected by the pre-registered rule.

A-S4.description: A-S1 adjusted by drought, insured losses and FSA changes.

A-S5.description: Change in FSA's silage share applied to last year.

A-S6.description: A-S2 in high-coverage states, A-S4 elsewhere.

A-S7.description: Drought scenario, not the headline. Smoothed state level (EWMA in logs) + drought chopping: gamma x max(0, D2+ share - 0.10) x last year's grain acres. Tier A twin of smoothed_chopping; scored post hoc.

B-S6.description: Headline silage. Smoothed state level (EWMA in logs) + drought chopping from NASS's in-season yield shortfall x last year's final grain acres. Uses NASS's yield forecast, never its acreage forecast. Ties the Tier C smoothed_chopping model.

B-G0.description: NASS planted x last year's grain share.

B-G1.description: NASS planted x this year's FSA grain share x last year's correction.

B-G2.description: Ridge on FSA share change, yield shock, drought, condition, losses.

B-G3.description: Monotone boosted trees on the B-G2 inputs.

B-G4.description: Daniel's GBT without NASS's grain forecast (reference).

B-G5.description: B-G1 with the median correction of the last three years.

B-G7.description: Geometric mean of B-G5 and A-G3. Selected Tier B grain.

B-S1.description: Reversion + planted change and FSA non-grain share change.

B-S2.description: Reversion + yield shock, drought, condition, insured losses.

B-S3.description: Reversion + milk-cow change and FSA silage change.

B-S4.description: Monotone boosted trees on the B-S2 and B-S3 inputs.

B-S5.description: NASS planted - Tier B grain, x last year's silage share.

B-S5b.description: B-S5 with FSA-scaled planted where NASS has only March figures. Selected Tier B silage.
